title: Covid-19 Vaccines As a Condition of Employment: Impact on Uptake, Staffing, and Mortality in Elderly Care Homes
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: the English care-home vaccine mandate (event1) starts in the same week for every English local authority (post = yw >= max(yw if event1==1)). Main estimates (Figures 4-6, Tables 2-3) use the generalized synthetic control / interactive fixed effects estimator (fect, method ife) with covariates; Figure 7 / Table 3 use a triple-difference event study (xtreg i.england##i.pre##i.D_staff ... with covariates). No staggered adoption, synthetic-control-type estimator, and covariates throughout.
design_notes: Package replication_package_MS-HCM-22-03405: Datasets/COVID_paper.dta (LA-week panel), carenational_mansci.dta, carela_mansci.dta, relative_time.dta; do_files/master_main.do, FIG4-7.do, Table2-4.do, appendix FIGA*.do; ado_files include fect.ado. Weekly LA-level data for England and Wales, care homes vs other social care vs domestic deaths.
